mapper.select:
WITH bounds AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT env AS g3857, ST_Transform(env, 4326) AS g4326 FROM (SELECT ST_TileEnvelope(#{z}, #{x}, #{y}) AS env) envelope ), hits AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT AS geom, COALESCE(f.name, '') AS name, f.sub_type AS subtype, f.layer AS layer, f.region_code AS region, CAST(f.osm_id AS text) AS osm_id FROM osm_feature f CROSS JOIN bounds b WHERE f.layer = #{layer}
), rows AS ( SELECT ST_AsMVTGeom(ST_Transform(h.geom, 3857), b.g3857, 4096, 64, true) AS geom, h.name, h.subtype, h.layer, h.region, h.osm_id FROM hits h CROSS JOIN bounds b ) SELECT encode(ST_AsMVT(rows, #{layer}, 4096, 'geom'), 'base64') FROM rows WHERE geom IS NOT NULL
SELECT DISTINCT region_code FROM osm_feature ORDER BY 1
